summary: Meta AI's Alexandr Wang announced the rollout of Muse Voice Transcribe, described as the lab's first real-time audio perception model, claiming state-of-the-art streaming speech-to-text with native speaker diarization and endpointing in a single model.

mechanisms.reason: The post claims a first-of-kind real-time audio perception model that natively unifies transcription, diarization and endpointing, a new task-class capability rather than an incremental refresh.
mechanisms.quote: our first real-time audio perception model - SOTA in streaming speech-to-text. also handles speaker diarization and endpointing natively in a single model.

practices.reason: A team building voice pipelines could consider consolidating separate STT, diarization and endpointing components into this single model, though the SOTA claim is unreplicated and no benchmark figures are given.
practices.quote: SOTA in streaming speech-to-text. also handles speaker diarization and endpointing natively in a single model.
